{{Top|leg}}
'''The Life''' was the middle level of [[Vergesso Base]], and was dedicated to servicing of the crews of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] docked at [[The Facility]] level. The Life had off-ship quarters available for rental by starship crews, as well as shops, [[Cantina/Legends|bars]], and entertainment facilities. 
==Layout==
Several services were located in The Life, including quarters that accommodated pilots and crews who wanted to spend time away from their ships. The simpler sleeping quarters costed 100 [[Galactic_Credit_Standard/Legends|credits]] per night; the larger ones, containing living rooms and [[autochef]], costed at least 300.

The shadowport attracted several businesses from all around [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Intoxicant retailer [[Happy Spacer]] run by the [[Teltior]] [[Loeerna]], the [[Wisel's|arms merchant shop]] run by [[Wisel]], a dozen [[Drug dealer|spice dealers]], notably including [[D'ring'my]], and the [[Carosite]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Parnath]]. Vergesso was a main distribution point for illegal holos, and bootleggers sold their wares, such as scarlet-rated [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order|COMPNOR]] Art, Alliance propaganda beamcasts and other media blacklisted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Data couriers, [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] and [[information broker/Legends|infochants]] looked for hire or sold information.

The Life also hosted several bars both small (mainly for the locals) and big that were constantly open. The [[Docking Bay (cantina)|Docking Bay]] was a dive bar run by the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Phrusaani]]. A rougher bar, the [[Black Hole (Vergesso Base)|Black Hole]], catered to [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]]; it was run by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Djarri]]. [[Norric's]] was the smallest bar, and was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] personnel on Vergesso.

Other services available included [[sun room]]s for 2 credits per hour, [[agro-pod]]s, [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheaters]] with action holos between 5 and 10 credits, even dancers for 100 credits. There was an arcade with amusements such as [[Declination/Legends|Declination]], the local popular [[spheroids]], and [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. A large area close to the Alliance [[hangar/Legends|docking bays]] was dedicated to Rebel pilots and affiliates, while other areas served as headquarters for [[Natori Association]] and [[Galindas Exports]], branches of [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss]].
